title: Herschel Walker denies in ‘strongest possible terms’ report he paid for abortion
notes: Chosen from New Gray's ranked list of three reports of the allegation (CNN, the AP's story in a daily's carry, GBH's copy of the AP) as the first that Wayback holds and that passes the read-only check; the other two were not read. A located copy: the capture, of 03:40:15 UTC on 2022-10-04, prints By Eric Bradner, CNN, Updated 11:10 PM EDT, Mon October 3, 2022 (03:10 UTC on 2022-10-04): October 3 in Eastern time, October 4 in UTC. It prints no first-publication time. It reports that "Walker's denial came shortly after the Daily Beast reported he had paid for a woman's abortion".
